sentences.simplified: 我爸爸在电脑公司工作。
sentences.traditional: 我爸爸在電腦公司工作。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bàba zài diànnǎo gōngsī gōngzuò.
sentences.english: My dad works at a computer company.

sentences.simplified: 她妈妈是老师，每天都很忙。
sentences.traditional: 她媽媽是老師，每天都很忙。
sentences.pinyin: Tā māma shì lǎoshī, měitiān dōu hěn máng.
sentences.english: Her mom is a teacher, and she is very busy every day.

sentences.simplified: 我哥哥是工程师，你哥哥呢？
sentences.traditional: 我哥哥是工程師，你哥哥呢？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gēge shì gōngchéngshī, nǐ gēge ne?
sentences.english: My older brother is an engineer; what about your older brother?

sentences.simplified: 王先生教法文，他说法文很好。
sentences.traditional: 王先生教法文，他說法文很好。
sentences.pinyin: Wáng xiānsheng jiāo Fǎwén, tā shuō Fǎwén hěn hǎo.
sentences.english: Mr. Wang teaches French; he speaks French very well.
